Event Ticket Range Check

At closing time, enter each stack’s first and last numbers and compare them with the issued range: covered, missing, duplicate and out-of-range tickets in one view. Serials keep their leading zeros, and every range names its stacks so you can pull the right paper stack again.

Printed digits and issued range

First confirm how many digits are printed on every ticket, then enter the issued first and last numbers, including leading zeros.

Ticket stacks

Give each stack a short name and its first and last numbers, up to 64 stacks. Names must be unique; if a stack has a gap in the middle, split it into two rows first. Empty rows are not submitted.

The sample is fixed placeholder data (issued 0001–0010, stacks A, B and C) for demonstration; press “Check ticket ranges” after loading to compute.
